sections.heading: 1. An easier lift-in
lines: ① Open the door wide and face the car seat.
② Hold your toddler close to your body.
③ Put one knee on the back seat to get closer.
④ Can they walk? Let them climb in themselves.

sections.heading: 2. Stop if…
lines: Pain or tingling spreads down a leg,
or it feels weak — stop and get advice.

caption:
For Lulu, lifting his toddler into the car seat is harder than anything on site. Every twist and reach gives his back a twinge.

The further you reach, and the more you twist while holding a load, the harder your back works. Face the car seat, hold your toddler close, and turn with your feet rather than your back.

Hybi's tips: open the door wide, put one knee on the back seat to get closer, and if your little one can walk, let them climb in themselves.

Tingling or weakness down a leg, or no change after two weeks, is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
